description: Source code for the uci_indication_selector class, handling UCI indication processing, timeout management, and scheduling in a wireless communication scheduler.

classes.name: uci_indication_selector
classes.description: Class responsible for managing UCI indication processing, timeout handling, and scheduling logic.

methods.name: create_action
methods.description: Converts a UCI PDU into a UCI action, extracting relevant fields based on PDU type.

methods.name: has_harq_ack_bits
methods.description: Checks if a UCI PDU contains HARQ acknowledgment bits.

methods.name: handle_uci_ind_pdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming UCI indication PDU, updating internal state and generating actions.

methods.name: handle_uci_pdu
methods.description: Handles a specific UCI PDU within an existing UCI entry, updating or finalizing the UCI action.

methods.name: handle_timeouts
methods.description: Manages UCI timeouts, including forced NACKs and cleanup of expired entries.

methods.name: handle_result
methods.description: Processes scheduling results, updating UCI grants and managing timeout wheels.

methods.name: handle_discarded_ucis
methods.description: Handles UCI entries that are discarded, forcing timeouts and cleaning up resources.
